_comment: Team config — committed to obsidian-memory so teammates discover the company vault automatically. Edit `company_vault_url` once when the GitHub repo exists; everyone who clones obsidian-memory after that gets one-command onboarding via `setup.sh --author "Name"` (no flags needed for the company vault). The clone URL itself isn't a secret — the repo it points at is private, so only authorized teammates can actually clone it.
